prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create ONE continuous vertically scrolling iPhone home-page design for 多多打卡, suitable as a developer reference. NOT a presentation board. NOT several screens side by side.

CANVAS IS CRITICAL: logical width exactly 414 points, full page roughly 2700–3000 points tall, rendered at 2x if possible (828 pixels wide, about 5600 pixels tall). Very tall narrow long screenshot. Grow height to fit ALL content; do not shorten the page or omit tasks. Edges of the image ARE the app screen edges. No phone hardware, no black frame, no Dynamic Island, no outer margin, no surrounding backdrop, no labels outside app, no landscape layout. One native navigation bar at the very TOP, one native tab bar at the very BOTTOM, no repeated nav/tab bars in the middle.

REFERENCES:
Image 1 = exact visual reference for the hero, star journey panel, CARD CONTENT and task states. Copy these closely, including green completed cards, running homework ending control, disabled locked task.
Image 2 = reference ONLY for decorative four section containers: orange food base, purple observatory, cyan home pods, pink courage base. Preserve these cute small themed buildings and dimensional group borders.
REMOVE all atmospheric clouds/space/background imagery OUTSIDE the hero and group header decorations. Page ground is flat uniform iOS very light gray #F2F2F7. No cosmic page background. Keep hero's own panda/rocket scene INSIDE hero card. Keep section toy buildings compact inside the 414pt viewport. Premium clean native iOS Chinese typography and comfortable spacing.

LAYOUT in ONE continuous vertical column:
- 414pt full width. 16pt content side margins. 382pt wide panels.
- Native top status bar with 9:41 then native navigation 多多打卡, info.circle left, shield right, light system chrome.
- Hero exactly reference 1: navy 今天也要 / 闪闪发光！ on left, panda astronaut and rocket on right, native bolt progress 6 / 13, 再得7分，飞船就能出发啦！. Under hero a native counter strip: 7 今日自评; 6 有效打卡; 0 奖励分; 家长确认.
- Journey panel EXACTLY image 1 first screen journey style: white softly rounded card; small globe left of 我的星际旅程, subtitle 每50分解锁星球, on right 本月 6 / 50 and chevron. Below a little launching red-white rocket at left and rising/falling blue dashed flight route connecting four clay planets 水星, 金星, 地球, 火星. Below 水星 show 6 / 50; later planets have locks and 未解锁. It is decorative illustration plus native labels. Preserve this shape/composition and content, NOT the plain four equal-row planets of the current implementation.
- Four complete task sections in exact order below.
- Native footer tab bar at absolute bottom: selected 今日打卡 (star), 打卡统计 (bars), 积分消耗 (star-circle); standard system style from image1, with home indicator. No invented game navigation.

TASK LAYOUT IS MANDATORY: ALWAYS TWO EQUAL-WIDTH COLUMNS (roughly177pt cards) with 8pt gap. Every task has its own tile. Odd final task stays LEFT HALF-WIDTH, empty right slot; never full-width. All 17 tasks must be present exactly once. Cards adopt IMAGE 1's double-column anatomy: task name and gold star points at top, large centered clay illustration, concise timer or short supporting line, state or action below. Courage also uses two columns, translating image1's content into tall tiles; do NOT copy its single-column layout.
Use native readable labels, not tiny text. Target 17pt names, 12-13pt details, 44pt tap areas. Task card heights about190–205pt, so full page must be tall. Do NOT squish the page to ordinary phone screen height.

STATES:
Completed cards have very pale mint fill, subtle translucent green circular approval stamp at top right, native green circle-check plus 已完成 at bottom, no colored start button. Running card shows a native timer glyph and 12:36, purple full-width 结束 button. Available tasks show group-colored rounded 开始 or 打卡. Locked task has desaturated art, muted text, gray lock button 尚未解锁. Add one pale amber pending example with 待确认 on 干净卫生. Do not add separate state tags like 未打卡 or 计时中.

EXACT SECTIONS/CARDS:
1 能量补给站, orange #FF8D28 dimensional frame. Header small orange food station left and orange-blue rover right, count 2 / 5.
 row1 left 起床 ★+1, illustration sun+blue bed, timer 07:12, 已完成 + mint approval stamp.
 row1 right 吃早饭 ★+1, breakfast bowl/toast+milk, timer 25:11 / 30, 已完成 + mint approval stamp.
 row2 left 吃午饭 ★+1, rice bowl+vegetables, timer 30分钟, orange 开始.
 row2 right 吃晚饭 ★+1, dinner vegetables+chicken, timer 30分钟, orange 开始.
 row3 left 睡觉 ★+1, moon with sleeping panda/pillow, 晚上9:30, orange 打卡. Right EMPTY.
2 知识探索站, lavender #B0A0FF dimensional frame. Telescope/books left and observatory dome right, count 1 / 3.
 row1 left 认真听讲 ★+2, headphones on books, 已完成 + mint approval stamp.
 row1 right 写作业 ★+2, orange pencil on lavender spiral notebook, timer 12:36, purple 结束.
 row2 left 阅读 ★+2, stacked books, timer 至少15分钟, purple 开始. Right EMPTY.
3 生活空间站, cyan #00D2E0 dimensional frame. Cyan little home capsules/mint shrubs at header corners, count 3 / 5.
 row1 left 收拾玩具 ★+1, teddy bear in yellow toy box, 已完成 + mint approval stamp.
 row1 right 打扫卫生 ★+1, yellow broom with purple sleeve and sparkle, cyan 打卡.
 row2 left 洗漱 ★+1, blue toothbrush cup and duck, 20:35, 已完成 + mint approval stamp.
 row2 right 干净卫生 ★+1, folded towels and soap, 20:40, pale amber 待确认 (unapproved, no stamp).
 row3 left 自己穿衣 ★+1, blue top and folded pants, cyan 打卡. Right EMPTY.
4 勇气成长站, rose #FF375F dimensional frame. Rose dome with star/heart door and flag base, count 0 / 4.
 row1 left 乖巧听话 ★+2, panda hugging pink heart, supporting text 认真回应，做好宝宝, rose 打卡.
 row1 right 不发脾气 ★+2, calm seated panda with mint leaves, supporting text 做情绪的小主人, rose 打卡.
 row2 left 做事不拖拉 ★+2, lavender lightning+gold star (desaturated), supporting 三餐、作业后解锁, gray lock 尚未解锁.
 row2 right 诚实守信 ★+1, pink shield with check, supporting 说真话，不撒谎, rose 打卡.

Keep all text accurate in simplified Chinese. Same cute clay panda/toy assets and restrained native card look as reference1, rich header frames as reference2. Nothing outside app rectangle. NO general cosmic background, NO multiple phones, NO external headings, NO missing groups or tasks, NO single-column cards, NO panoramic board. This is a complete full-page LONG SCREENSHOT at logical width414.
